definition: Instrument for X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy used to acquire XPS spectra and quantification data for PEMFC-relevant surface-chemistry characterization.

label: XPS Pass Energy
definition: An energy characteristic specifying the energy associated with xps pass.
rationale: Published term retained outside the 2.2 correction-guide decision set; definition normalized in the authoritative registry.

label: XPS Take Off Angle
alt_labels: emission angle | photoelectron take-off angle | take-off angle
definition: A geometric characteristic specifying the angle associated with xps take off.
rationale: Published term retained outside the 2.2 correction-guide decision set; definition normalized in the authoritative registry.

label: XRD Pattern Dataset
definition: Dataset of X-ray diffraction patterns or diffractograms generated during catalyst and electrode material characterization.

label: XRD Peak FWHM
definition: A property denoting xRD peak full width at half maximum (degrees).

label: XRD Peak Position 2 Theta
definition: A property denoting xRD peak position expressed in 2θ angle (degrees).

label: XRD Step Size
definition: A geometric characteristic specifying xrd step size under the conditions and reference basis stated with the record.
rationale: Published term retained outside the 2.2 correction-guide decision set; definition normalized in the authoritative registry.

label: XRD Two Theta End
definition: A quantitative characteristic specifying xrd two theta end under the conditions and reference basis stated with the record.
rationale: Published term retained outside the 2.2 correction-guide decision set; definition normalized in the authoritative registry.

label: XRD Two Theta Start
definition: A quantitative characteristic specifying xrd two theta start under the conditions and reference basis stated with the record.
rationale: Published term retained outside the 2.2 correction-guide decision set; definition normalized in the authoritative registry.

label: Xrite Optical Property Measurement
definition: A measurement process that uses xrite optical property measurement to determine Transparency, Delta S, and Color Difference Delta Eab using Xrite Spectrophotometer.

label: Xrite Spectrophotometer
definition: Spectrophotometer used to measure optical properties (ΔE, etc.) of printed films (Section 2.4.1.5).

label: XTM Scan Time
definition: A temporal characteristic specifying the elapsed time associated with xtm scan.
rationale: Published term retained outside the 2.2 correction-guide decision set; definition normalized in the authoritative registry.

label: XY Moving Stage
alt_labels: computer-controlled X–Y stage | custom-built XY stage | rastering stage
definition: A positioning component that translates a mounted specimen, substrate, or tool along two independently controlled orthogonal axes.

label: Yield Stress
alt_labels: gel strength | shear yield stress | tau_y
definition: A property denoting stress at which ink transitions from solid-like to liquid-like behavior (taken at G'/G" crossover).

label: Youngs Modulus
definition: A property denoting young’s modulus of membrane (undoped/doped).

label: Zero Shear Viscosity
definition: A property denoting zero shear viscosity and determined in Rheology Measurement.

label: Zeta Potential
alt_labels: electrokinetic potential | surface zeta potential | ζ-potential
definition: A property denoting zeta potential of colloidal particles in ink; indicator of dispersion stability.

label: Zeta Potential Analyzer
definition: An instrument that measures an electrokinetic response, commonly electrophoretic mobility, and estimates zeta potential using an appropriate electrokinetic model.

label: Zeta Potential Measurement
alt_labels: electrophoretic mobility measurement | surface zeta potential | ζ-potential measurement
definition: Measurement of zeta potential to assess colloidal stability of catalyst inks.

label: Zeta Potential Stability Threshold
definition: A specified magnitude of zeta potential used as an operational electrostatic-stability criterion for a dispersion under stated medium, pH, ionic-strength and assessment conditions.

label: ZIF 67
definition: Metal–organic framework precursor (ZIF-67) used as template/precursor to generate NCNTFs support during pyrolysis.

label: Zirconia Milling Balls
definition: Zirconia (ZrO2) spherical milling media added during ball milling to enhance dispersion (paper uses 3 mm spheres).

label: Zirconium Diboride Powder
definition: ZrB2 ceramic powder used as UHTC phase in DIW inks; average particle size reported before/after milling.

label: Zr B 2 Volume Percent
definition: A geometric characteristic that represents zr b 2 volume percent for a material, component, process, measurement, or hydrogen-electrochemical system.
rationale: Deprecated safely because the source does not establish one unambiguous scientific identity.
